text:
Leah (People Ops): Mateo mentioned he’s starting parental leave 2027-07-01 and will be relocating to Spain right before leave. Need to confirm international payroll, Spanish statutory leave interactions, and visa/remote-work implications. Also he asked about childcare subsidy eligibility while abroad. Quick Qs: does Redwood top-up apply if payroll moves offshore? Who owns the visa checklist?

Mateo: Correct — moving to Spain 6/25, start leave 7/01 for ~16 weeks. Partner is on Spanish social security; I plan to register with local Seguridad Social. I’d like Redwood supplement if eligible. Also need guidance on bank/payment while abroad.

Ivy (Manager): Team can cover Mateo’s work. We’ll need a short handoff and to confirm whether payroll stays US-based or transfers to Spain. If payroll moves, we’ll need Legal + Benefits sign-off before payroll cutoff.

Benefits-bot: Redwood supplement eligibility requires employee to be on Redwood payroll and enrolled in a Redwood benefits plan for the pay period of the supplement. International payroll moves may affect eligibility. Please submit International Leave Form by 2027-06-01.

Legal: We’ll need Mateo to complete the Remote-Work Abroad questionnaire and confirm tax residency. If you’re on Spanish social security you may be subject to local statutory leave rules; Redwood may need to coordinate with local counsel. I can start the intake.

Leah (People Ops): Action items draft: 1) Mateo complete International Leave Form + Remote-Work questionnaire by 2027-05-20; 2) Benefits to confirm top-up rules if payroll changes by 2027-05-28; 3) Legal to advise on visa/tax by 2027-06-10; 4) Manager to post coverage plan + handoff by 2027-06-15.

Mateo: I’ll fill the forms tonight. Regarding childcare subsidy: my partner is applying for local municipal childcare and asked if Redwood’s childcare reimbursement applies for expenses incurred abroad.

Benefits-bot: Redwood’s Childcare Reimbursement generally covers eligible childcare expenses for employees and dependents. For expenses incurred abroad, we require receipts and a translation if not in English. Maximum yearly cap applies; please file via the Expense portal and tag as "international childcare".

Legal: Note also that EU leave laws may provide different notice and documentation requirements. Mateo, please upload your relocation lease + local social security registration once complete; we’ll attach to the case file.

Ivy (Manager): For performance review timing: propose we defer the calibrated rating until Mateo returns and document in the review system "international parental leave deferred". We can do a 20m pre-leave sync next week to capture feedback.

Leah (People Ops): Thanks all — I’ll track these in the leave packet and ping again for any missing docs. people-ops-bot: creating case ID IL-20270701-12.

people-ops-bot: Case IL-20270701-12 created. Reminders scheduled for International Leave Form (2027-05-20) and Supplement confirmation (2027-05-28).
